name: diff_check_309_accuracy_v1
written: 20 November 2026, by the #309 lane, before any run (D-847, D-848)
terms: Synthetic clause text written for this set; no real agreement is quoted. Free to use.
rule: expected: the kinds a question must flag (a settled Yes on at least one change of the pair). tolerated: kinds the writer holds arguable for this pair (a dropped condition often also widens what a rule covers); a flag there counts neither way. Every other kind asked must not be flagged. Development material: never a bar reading.

pairs.source: The Supplier may suspend deliveries if the Buyer has not paid an invoice within sixty days of its due date.
pairs.proposed: The Supplier may suspend deliveries at any time.

pairs.source: Either party may disclose Confidential Information to its advisers, provided that the advisers are bound by a duty of confidentiality.
pairs.proposed: Either party may disclose Confidential Information to its advisers.

pairs.source: The Contractor shall be paid the final instalment once the works have passed the acceptance test.
pairs.proposed: The Contractor shall be paid the final instalment on completion of the works.

pairs.source: The Tenant may sublet the premises with the prior written consent of the Landlord.
pairs.proposed: The Tenant may sublet the premises.

pairs.source: Unless the delay is caused by force majeure, the Seller shall pay a penalty of one percent for each week of delay.
pairs.proposed: The Seller shall pay a penalty of one percent for each week of delay.

pairs.source: Neither party shall solicit the employees of the other party during the term of this Agreement.
pairs.proposed: The Supplier shall not solicit the employees of the Customer during the term of this Agreement.

pairs.source: Each party shall keep the terms of this Agreement confidential.
pairs.proposed: The Licensee shall keep the terms of this Agreement confidential.

pairs.source: Neither party may assign its rights under this Agreement without the consent of the other.
pairs.proposed: The Distributor may not assign its rights under this Agreement without the consent of the Principal.

pairs.source: The parties shall not make any public announcement about this Agreement without mutual approval.
pairs.proposed: Party B shall not make any public announcement about this Agreement without the approval of Party A.

pairs.source: Neither Member State shall impose new customs duties on goods originating in the other.
pairs.proposed: State A shall not impose new customs duties on goods originating in State B.

pairs.source: This warranty covers defects in materials reported within twelve months of delivery.
pairs.proposed: This warranty covers defects in materials or workmanship reported within twenty-four months of delivery.

pairs.source: The licence permits use of the software on one computer at the head office of the Licensee.
pairs.proposed: The licence permits use of the software on any computer of the Licensee or its affiliates.

pairs.source: The Agent shall represent the Principal in the territory of France.
pairs.proposed: The Agent shall represent the Principal in the territory of the European Union.

pairs.source: The indemnity applies to claims brought by third parties.
pairs.proposed: The indemnity applies to all claims, losses and costs of any kind.

pairs.source: The restriction applies to the subsidiaries of the Seller.
pairs.proposed: The restriction applies to the subsidiaries, affiliates, agents and contractors of the Seller.

pairs.source: The Supplier shall maintain insurance against public liability for the term of this Agreement.
pairs.proposed: The Supplier intends to maintain insurance against public liability for the term of this Agreement.

pairs.source: The Buyer must notify the Seller of any defect within ten days.
pairs.proposed: The Buyer usually notifies the Seller of any defect within ten days.

pairs.source: Each party shall comply with all applicable laws in performing this Agreement.
pairs.proposed: Each party is committed to the principle of respecting applicable laws in performing this Agreement.

pairs.source: The Contractor shall complete the works by 31 March.
pairs.proposed: The Contractor expects to complete the works by 31 March.

pairs.source: The State Parties shall report on the measures taken every two years.
pairs.proposed: The State Parties recognise the value of reporting on the measures taken every two years.

red_lines.quote: Customer data must remain stored within the European Union.

pairs.source: The Processor shall store all customer data in data centres located in the European Union.
pairs.proposed: The Processor may store customer data in any data centre it operates worldwide.

red_lines.quote: The liability cap must not be lower than the total fees paid.

pairs.source: The total liability of the Supplier is limited to the fees paid in the previous twelve months.
pairs.proposed: The total liability of the Supplier is limited to twice the fees paid in the previous twelve months.

pairs.source: The Buyer shall pay each invoice within thirty days of receipt.
pairs.proposed: Each invoice shall be paid by the Buyer within thirty days of its receipt.

pairs.source: The Agreement starts on the date of signature. It runs for three years.
pairs.proposed: The Agreement starts on the date of signature. It runs for three years. The headings in this Agreement are for convenience only.
